name: unknown-distribution
code: parameters { real x; } model { x ~ mystery(0); }

name: duplicate-variable
code: data { int x; int x; } model {}

name: bad-function-return
code: functions { real f(real x) { return [x]'; } } model {}

name: non-data-size
code: parameters { real n; vector[n] x; } model {}

name: sampling-in-data
code: model {} generated quantities { real x; x ~ normal(0, 1); }

name: void-value
code: functions { void f() { return; } } transformed data { real x = f(); } model {}

name: array-rank-mismatch
code: data { array[2] real x; } transformed data { real y = x; } model {}

name: matrix-shape-mismatch
code: data { matrix[2,3] x; } transformed data { real z = x; } model {}

name: reserved-redeclaration
code: functions { real f(real x) { return x; } real f(real x) { return x; } } model {}
